canada.title: ‘Want to see more’: Further action demanded after 7 Montreal police officers fired
canada.summary: Activists are cautiously welcoming the firing of seven officers over misconduct allegations, calling the move a step toward accountability while also pressing for further action.
canada.outlet: Global News, CBC News, Ottawa Citizen

canada.title: Collision expert tells trial that truck driver ran red light, caused fatal Regina bus stop crash
canada.summary: A police collision investigator told Regina provincial court Tuesday that a deadly crash could have been avoided.

canada.title: Edmonton mayor, council give initial nod to city’s four-year budget plan, including 4.9% property tax hike
canada.summary: The day after Edmonton city administration released the 2027-2030 operating and capital budgets, which managers describe as back-to-basic blueprints, Mayor Andrew Knack said he’s generally OK with the proposed 4.9 per cent property tax increase for 2027.

canada.title: New Alberta bill would compel ‘neutrality’ for post-secondary institutions on political issues
canada.summary: Universities will be compelled to stay neutral and allow freedom of expression if the Alberta legislature passes a new bill introduced by the United Conservative government on Tuesday.

canada.title: Mother dead, daughter missing in suspected grizzly bear attack near Bella Coola
canada.summary: Family members have identified the two victims of a suspected fatal grizzly bear attack near Bella Coola, B.C., as Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20.
canada.outlet: CBC News, Global News, Vancouver Sun

canada.title: Auditor general issues damning report on Nunavut's family services, again
canada.summary: More than three years after Canada's auditor general issued an "urgent call to action" to improve Nunavut's troubled child and family services, another follow-up report says little has been done to fix things, and the urgency remains.

canada.title: Whitehorse discusses roughly $210 million in infrastructure proposals with Ottawa
canada.summary: Mayor highlights new fire hall, arena upgrades, and local infrastructure projects

canada.title: Akwesasne family carries on 16th century Haudenosaunee tradition
canada.summary: A family from the Mohawk Territory of Akwesasne is carrying on a Haudenosaunee tradition from the 16th century.

canada.title: 3.4 magnitude earthquake near Esterhazy, Sask., likely caused by mining, Natural Resources Canada says
canada.summary: The earthquake — measured at a 3.4 magnitude — struck at 7:04 a.m. CST. Its epicentre was about nine kilometres east-northeast of Esterhazy, according to the NRC's Earthquake Canada website.

canada.title: Ontario won't make career college OSAP audit public, minister says
canada.summary: Ontario's colleges and universities minister says he will not be releasing a government-commissioned audit into student financial aid usage at career colleges.

canada.title: PM, Manitoba premier only ones to bring up abolishing Indian Act at meeting: AFN chief
canada.summary: The national chief of the Assembly of First Nations says the only leaders to discuss abolishing the Indian Act during a landmark meeting last week were Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew and Prime Minister Mark Carney.

canada.title: Auditor General finds Nunavut foster care continues to fail vulnerable children
canada.summary: The Auditor General of Canada found the Nunavut's foster-care system fails to meet its own standards in providing safe homes for children.
canada.outlet: APTN News, Nunatsiaq News, Ottawa Citizen

canada.title: Bypass that allowed sewage to spill into Red River wasn't supposed to open automatically: city official
canada.summary: A spill that unexpectedly discharged millions of litres of raw sewage into the Red River on Monday isn't expected to have a long-term impact on water quality, the City of Winnipeg's water and waste director says.

canada.title: Judge orders Bitcoin, laptop be returned to convicted killer William Sandeson
canada.summary: A judge has ordered a laptop containing William Sandeson’s Bitcoin returned to his family, with its disputed value ranging from $8,000 to over $200,000.

canada.title: Former officer accused in 3 sexual assault cases no longer employed by RCMP
canada.summary: The third case of sexual assault involving a former RCMP constable was dismissed on Monday after the Crown brought no evidence. The RCMP said Tuesday William McNutt, 41, is now no longer an employee.

canada.title: Toronto police investigating second report of pins found in Halloween candy
canada.summary: The update expands on an investigation after a Toronto family discovered sewing needles and pins embedded in Halloween treats.

canada.title: Convicted B.C. killer no longer enrolled at McGill after admission controversy
canada.summary: McGill University is reviewing its admissions procedures after a convicted murderer on day parole was admitted to its Faculty of Law, with the university confirming that the individual is no longer enrolled.

canada.title: Rally held in Pugwash to support survivor of intimate partner violence
canada.summary: People packed a community hall in Pugwash, N.S., on Sunday to show support for a woman who was viciously attacked by her former partner.
